programme.title: Instinto Predador
programme.desc: Um navio grego transporta animais exóticos perigosos da Amazónia, incluindo um raro jaguar branco. Nessa mesma embarcação, um assassino, que estava a ser extraditado em segredo para os EUA, consegue fugir e libertar todos os animais em cativeiro, deixando os tripulantes em perigo de vida.

programme.title: Boss Level - O Último Nível
programme.desc: Preso num loop temporal que repete constantemente o dia que desemboca na sua morte, Roy Pulver, um antigo agente das forças especiais, empreende uma corrida contra o tempo para tentar acumular informação que evite o seu desfecho fatal e salve a mulher que ama.

programme.title: O Enigma Da Rosa
programme.desc: Uma família vê a filha mais nova ser raptada a caminho da escola e recebe uma carta do raptor a pedir um encontro antes de libertá-la. Para surpresa de todos, em vez de dinheiro, o raptor quer a confissão do segredo de um dos membros da família.

programme.title: Rapazes Nas Árvores
programme.desc: Na noite de Halloween de 1997, Corey, Jango e o restante grupo de skaters despedem-se do liceu, mas o primeiro reencontra Jonah, seu amigo da escola primária, vítima de crueldade por parte do segundo, e o percurso de ambos de regresso a casa torna-se cada vez mais estranho e assustador.

programme.title: Tempo De Sacrifício
programme.desc: Na Inglaterra do século XIV, um padre em fuga envolve-se com um grupo itinerante de atores, que descobre que ocorreu um homicídio e tenta resolvê-lo recriando o crime numa peça.

programme.title: A Minha Grande Noite
programme.desc: Jose é enviado por uma agência de trabalho para colaborar na gravação do programa de televisão Especial de Ano Novo, a meio de Agosto. Centenas de pessoas fingem rir-se e celebrar a falsa passagem de ano uma e outra vez Ninguém está feliz

programme.title: Charada
programme.desc: Depois de se apaixonar pelo elegante Peter numas férias na neve, Regina regressa a Paris onde descobre que o marido, de quem se estava a divorciar, foi assassinado, e que há três ex-soldados a persegui-la pela fortuna que roubaram durante a guerra. Em quem poderá ela confiar

programme.title: Milagre De Lourdes
programme.desc: O drama religioso, dedicado às aparições de Nossa Senhora na vida de Santa Bernadette, foi filmado em Portugal e conta com um grande elenco português. O filme apresenta uma Bernadette com 14 anos a lutar para ser ouvida e que sofreu pela sua determinação.

programme.title: Uma Noite Com O Presidente
programme.desc: Andrew Shepherd é um Presidente dos EUA viúvo, que se apaixona por uma ecologista de um grupo de pressão e que, quando começa a sair com ela, vê-se a perder votos a toda a velocidade.

programme.title: Fortaleza
programme.desc: Robert vive numa espécie de estância natural criada para oficiais reformados dos serviços secretos dos EUA. Quando um grupo de criminosos invade o complexo com intenções de o matar, ele vai ter de encontrar um modo de proteger as vidas de todos os que lá se encontram.

programme.title: Fortaleza Segurança Máxima
programme.desc: Semanas após o mortífero ataque ao Campo Fortaleza, Robert faz uma ousada tentativa para resgatar a viúva do seu antigo inimigo Balzary. E enquanto um novo ataque ameaça a estabilidade daquele espaço, Robert é obrigado a encontrar-se com alguém que nunca mais esperava voltar a ver...

programme.title: A Força Em Alerta
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas toma de assalto um couraçado da marinha americana, a única pessoa capaz de os deter é um ex-Navy Seal que é atualmente o cozinheiro da embarcação.

programme.title: Triângulo Da Tristeza
programme.desc: Um casal de modelos célebres embarca num cruzeiro luxuoso, com convidados muito ricos que fazem exigências loucas aos empregados, até que o barco naufraga e os passageiros se vêem encalhados numa ilha deserta, onde a hierarquia do barco sofre uma inesperada reviravolta.

programme.title: Vendeta
programme.desc: Três amigos casados reúnem-se para um encontro anual de caça numa zona de deserto mas um deles traz consigo a jovem amante e a situação fica rapidamente fora de controlo. Deixada como morta no meio de um deserto infernal, a rapariga vai vingar-se e caçá-los um a um...

programme.title: Panamá
programme.desc: Em 1989, numa época de turbulência profunda no Panamá, o ex-marine James Becker chega à paisana ao país para negociar um acordo que envolve armas de fogo, mas acaba por se ver envolvido na invasão americana do país e aprende uma lição fundamental sobre a natureza do poder político.

programme.title: Hardcore
programme.desc: Henry é ressuscitado da morte sem memória do seu passado e tem de salvar a sua mulher de um senhor da guerra com poderes de telecinesia, um exército de mercenários e um plano para dominar o mundo.

programme.title: The Reckoning - O Derradeiro Julgamento
programme.desc: A Grande Peste espalhou no país um clima de medo, desconfiança e morte. Grace, uma jovem viúva, é falsamente acusada de bruxaria pelo senhorio depois deste a tentar forçar a pagar as dívidas com favores sexuais. Levada para a prisão, ela enfrentará a mais cruel tortura, mas não estará sozinha...

programme.title: Todos Sabem
programme.desc: Laura viaja com os filhos de Buenos Aires até à sua aldeia-natal perto de Madrid para assistir ao casamento da irmã, mas uma série de acontecimentos desencadeia uma crise familiar que vai expor segredos do passado.

programme.title: Raid - Pelotão Chanfrado
programme.desc: Uma mulher polícia desastrada e um oficial misógino formam uma terrível e temível dupla para restabelecer a ordem nas ruas de Paris.

programme.title: As Rainhas Do Desconto
programme.desc: Uma dona de casa aborrecida e frustrada, Connie Kaminski, e a sua melhor amiga JoJo Johnson, uma vlogger com muitos sonhos, criam um esquema de cupões de desconto que lhes vai valer vários milhões de dólares e muitas dores de cabeça.

programme.title: Intriga Internacional
programme.desc: Roger O. Thornhill é um executivo publicitário que é confundido com um agente federal por um grupo de espiões. O equívoco dá lugar a uma série de mal-entendidos, incluindo a acusação de homicídio, tentativas de rapto e perseguições, quer por parte dos espiões, quer por parte do governo.

programme.title: First Kill Caça Ao Homem
programme.desc: Will Beeman é um bem sucedido profissional de Wall Street cujo filho é raptado. Para resgatar o rapaz, ele terá ajudar o raptor a recuperar a chave que dá acesso ao dinheiro roubado num banco, sempre perseguido pelo chefe da polícia Marvin Howell.

programme.title: Greenland O Último Refúgio
programme.desc: Uma família luta pela sobrevivência quando um cometa destruidor de planetas chega à Terra. John Garrity, a sua ex-mulher e o seu filho fazem uma perigosa viagem até à sua derradeira esperança de salvação, à medida que a contagem decrescente para o apocalipse global se aproxima do zero.

programme.title: Covil De Ladrões
programme.desc: A unidade de elite de combate ao crime de Los Angeles, que nem sempre joga pelas regras, entra em confronto com o gangue de assalto a bancos mais bem sucedido da cidade. Quando os fora-da-lei decidem assaltar a Reserva Federal, qual dos dois se revelará o mais implacável

programme.title: O Legado
programme.desc: O patriarca de uma família rica e poderosa morre subitamente, deixando à sua filha um chocante legado secreto, que ameaça destruir a sua vida

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: Órfã A Origem
programme.desc: Depois de planear uma brilhante fuga de um hospital psiquiátrico na Estónia, Esther viaja até aos EUA passando-se pela filha desaparecida de uma família milionária. No entanto, após uma inesperada reviravolta, a mãe começa a desconfiar da criança assassina, e tudo faz para proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Fidelidade Sem Limite
programme.desc: Com o brutal mundo do crime de Bruxelas como pano de fundo, Gigi, um gangster de aspirações elevadas, vive uma história de amor proibido com Bibi, uma jovem corredora de automóveis.

programme.title: Homage to Yehudi Menuhin
programme.desc: On 22 April 2016, Yehudi Menuhin would have celebrated his 100th birthday. One of his most famous students - and one of his best friends - is violinist Daniel Hope. For him, Yehudi Menuhin was the reason he become a violinist. At first, his mother became the secretary of Menuhin when Daniel Hoe and his parents moved to London.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration - II
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: We all know 'The Four Seasons of Vivaldi', it is one of the 'hits' of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi’s famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV?

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Rodrigo - Concierto de Aranjuez
programme.desc: Juan Manuel Cañizares is the soloist in a performance of Joaquín Rodrigo's (1901-1999) Concierto de Aranjuez. He is accompanied by the Berliner Philharmoniker led by maestro Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a 'Concerto for piano without orchestra', in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 99
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979).

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of 'Overture Rosamunde' (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, the Netherlands in 2015. Schubert initially composed the Overture for Georg Ernst von hofmann's play 'Die Zauberharfe' ('The Magic Harp'), which premiered on August 19, 1820.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Sergei Prokofiev based his ballet ‘Romeo and Juliet’ on William Shakespeare's famous play of the same name, telling the story of two young lovers from the feuding families Montague and Capulet. Acclaimed French choreographer Jean-Christophe Maillot created a distinctive choreography of the ballet in 1996, which has been performed to great success the world over.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano plays Brahms and Beethoven
programme.desc: In this recital, Roberto Giordano plays the Six Pieces for Piano, op. 118 of Brahms, a collection completed in 1893 and dedicated to Clara Schumann who will be the penultimate produced by the composer during his lifetime. The concert program also includes two Beethoven sonatas, the famous Moonlight Sonata No. 14, op. 27, and Sonata No. 31, op. 110, one of the last sonatas signed by the composer.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his’ Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale’.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio “Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno” (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony’. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann’s four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sophia Burgos (USA, 1991) and pianist Daniel Gerzenberg (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Ich esse nun mein Brod nicht trocken mehr’, ‘Wer rief dich den?’, ‘Schweig’ einmal still, du garst’ger Schwätzer dort!

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures!

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 6, Op. 18 No. 6
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Mahler - The Song of Lamentation
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería and four vocal soloists in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s cantata ‘The Song of Lamentation’ (Das klagende Lied). Among the soloists are soprano Sally Dibblee, mezzo-soprano Marjorie Elinor Dix, tenor Arturo Chacón, and bass Stephen West.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony - Legends And Quests
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Mozart - Così fan tutte
programme.desc: Maestro Zubin Mehta leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s comic opera Così fan tutte (1790). Following the successful operas Le nozze di Figaro (1786) and Don Giovanni (1787), Così fan tutte was the third and last collaboration between Mozart and the Venetian librettist and poet Lorenzo Da Ponte.

programme.title: Igreja No Mundo

programme.title: Projecto Dai-Me Almas - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: O 'Projeto Dai-me Almas' traz-nos as realidades da missão de Portugal, bem como a apresentação das contas para os seus benfeitores.

programme.title: Palavra De Deus
programme.desc: O “Mais Saúde” é um programa moderno e dinâmico, no qual se mostram as principais tendências nas áreas de bem-estar, saúde, qualidade de vida e educação alimentar. Sempre sob o ponto de vista de vários profissionais, que trazem as melhores dicas para estimular um estilo de vida mais saudável, favorecendo o cuidado com o nosso corpo, templo do Espírito Santo.

programme.title: Biblia No Meu Dia A Dia - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: A Palavra de Deus, materializada nos livros da Bíblia, é uma dádiva para toda a humanidade, e para cada um de nós, de uma forma muito especial. Contudo, a fim de crescermos em amor em relação à Palavra, é preciso treino e persistência..

programme.title: O Poder Da Palavra - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: O Programa O PODER DA PALAVRA é apresentado por Luzia Santiago, co -fundadora da Comunidade Canção Nova. E estreia com o objetivo de proporcionar a leitura orante da Palavra de Deus que é capaz de dar sabor à vida e transformar todas as coisas. programme.title: Mete-te Na Minha Vida: João Neto
programme.desc: Neste programa documental de uma hora, acompanhamos um dia completo na vida de uma pessoa, que pode ser uma celebridade, um artista, um artesão ou alguém anónimo, como um taxista. Da manhã à noite, a câmara observa as rotinas, os gestos e os momentos mais banais ou marcantes do quotidiano, revelando vidas que podem ser surpreendentemente diferentes — ou profundamente semelhantes — à do espectador.

programme.title: A Letra: Celina Piedade - 'Calimero E A Pêra Verde'

programme.title: De Gente And De Vinha: O Último Negociante De Vinhos
programme.desc: De Gente And De Vinha, um retrato intimista do mundo vitivinícola, apresentado com o requinte e poesia do chef André Magalhães, percorre conversas e deambulações por entre quintas familiares, castas em extinção, tabernas e adegas centenárias.'Num território moldado pelo mar e pelo vento, onde ao longo dos séculos a vinha e os homens aprenderam a sobreviver na areia, António Bernardino Paulo da Silva continua a resistir.

programme.title: Pensar Portugal: Inteligência Artificial
programme.desc: Os debates 'Pensar Portugal' são o palco de reflexão do Conta Lá sobre os grandes temas que mexem com as nossas vidas. Neste espaço informativo escutamos e questionamos os melhores protagonistas e especialistas nas mais diversas áreas da vida portuguesa.

programme.title: Nave Voadora: Pombal
programme.desc: Em Pombal, a Biblioteca Itinerante aproxima gerações e histórias esquecidas. Rita Ferro Rodrigues acompanha Paulo Branco e Anabela Martins enquanto idosos relembram a vida no campo, cantigas antigas e aventuras do Marquês de Pombal, e crianças se encantam com livros como 'O Coelho vs. Macaco'. Aldeias quase desertas ganham movimento e afeto à medida que a leitura transforma a rotina em momentos de convívio.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 91
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 73
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 34
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 92
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. programme.title: Phalanx - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1985, jazz quartet Phalanx appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: Walter Trout Band - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.title: Michiel Borstlap: Blue, Reflective And Frames
programme.desc: Recorded at the Amsterdam Arena during the Amsterdam South East Jazz Festival, Michiel Borstlap tickles the ivories of his Steinway in performances of all his favourite songs on his solo albums ‘Blue’, ‘Reflective’, and ‘Frames’. An unprecedented event: a solo piano concert at the home base of football club Ajax Amsterdam!

programme.title: Portrait: Torino Jazz Festival
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet - Live Concert
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, West Of The West
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Turquoise
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Keb' Mo
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind And Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Bebop
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Schloss Ansbach: Ornette Coleman Sextet
programme.desc: ‘Harmolodics’, the musical philosophy of jazz saxophonist Ornette Coleman, is associated primarily with avant-garde jazz and the free jazz movement, although its implications extend beyond these limits. Coleman defined ‘harmolodics’ as “the use of the physical and the mental of one's own logic made into an expression of sound to bring about the musical sensation of unison executed by a single person or with a group”.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Peter Beets Trio And Goudsmit: Tribute to Montgomery
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: S. Quintet, Hubbard And Henderson - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Live in London
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, 'The Best Is Yet To Come,' 'Fly Me to the Moon,' and his signature song 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco.'.

programme.title: Tania Maria: Live at Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This performance of Brazilian Tania Maria promises to make you want to dance.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007.

programme.title: Lucky Chops - Live at BIRD
programme.desc: The NYC band Lucky Chops rose to fame when a video of their performance at a subway station went viral on YouTube in 2015. Since then, the energetic quintet has been entertaining audiences all over the world. The band was formed in 2006, when trumpeter Joshua Gawel, saxophonist Daro Behroozi, trombonist Josh Holcomb, tubist Raphael Buyo, and drummer Charles Sams, met during their education at Fiorello H.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Greatest Lady Vocalists
programme.desc: Arguably the greatest lady vocalists of all time are featured in this superb compilation. These historic recordings from the 1950s and 1960s offer a unique overview of different approaches to jazz singing that helped define the genre. Watch Billie Holiday’s performance of “God Bless The Child” closely and learn what made her such an influential jazz and pop singer.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Vein ft. Greg Osby
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Up Above My Head
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Blue Waters
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía And Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Caravan
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Visitor from Mars
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: Chick Corea Akoustic Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Live at Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Dutch free jazz, jazz rock, and electronic music pioneer Pierre Courbois threw a belated 80th birthday bash at Amsterdam’s renowned BIMhuis in January 2022. Courbois, a celebrated drummer and percussionist, also masters the tabla, conga, bass guitar, and vibraphone, and is a prolific writer with over 100 compositions to his credit.

programme.title: Songs She Never Heard
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra And Bert Joris - Big Valses
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: Sing Jazz, Singapore
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: Guitarlegend Wes Montgomery in The Netherlands
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the most unique and influential guitarists in music history. These beautifully filmed programs from the spring of 1965 feature Wes, in intimate studio settings, leading three different lineups through some of his best-known tunes, including “Four On Six”, “Jingles”, and “West Coast Blues”.

programme.title: Al Di Meola - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Solo
programme.desc: Pianist McCoy Tyner’s artistry and innovation embrace a multitude of styles, from African and Latin rhythms to the modal harmonies of the post-bebop era. His amazing versatility has enabled him to excel in a wide variety of settings.

programme.title: Django Memories
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Gilberto, Gillespie And Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Episode 4: Stan Getz - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz tenor saxophonist Stan Getz (1927-1991) was nicknamed 'The Sound' for his warm, lyrical tone. Performing in bebop and cool jazz groups, he popularized bossa nova in America with the hit 'The Girl from Ipanema'.

programme.title: Frederico Heliodoro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is Frederico Heliodoro.

programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Léon: Au-Delà de l'or
programme.desc: Après son sacre aux Jeux Olympiques en tant que meilleur nageur de sa génération, Léon Marchand prend une longue pause pour réfléchir sur qui il est et ce qu’il veut. À son retour, il réalise qu’il n’est plus au niveau et qu’il a perdu sa motivation. Commence alors un temps de choix, où de nouvelles ambitions émergent peu à peu.

programme.title: Léon: Au-Delà de l'or
programme.desc: À l’approche des championnats du monde de Singapour, la vie de Léon Marchand ne se résume plus à la natation. Entre l’obtention de son diplôme, les attentes qui pèsent désormais sur lui et sa collaboration artistique avec The Blaze, il doit apprendre à jongler entre plusieurs mondes sans se déconcentrer. Il n’est pas seulement question de performer en tant que sportif, il est question de s’accomplir en tant qu’adulte.

programme.desc: Deux jumelles que tout oppose échangent leurs vies pour un week-end. Mais un accident tragique provoque la mort d’Élodie (que tout le monde croit être Élisabeth). Piégée dans l’identité de sa sœur, Élisabeth doit affronter son mari, la famille Balint et une enquête criminelle. Très vite, elle comprend que derrière ce drame se cache un assassinat… et qu’elle est prise dans un terrible engrenage.

programme.title: Les Évaporés
programme.desc: Esther Bazin, commandante de police à Nantes, arrête enfin le tueur qu’elle traquait depuis trois ans sans relâche, au détriment de sa famille. Malgré ce succès, elle démissionne le jour même pour retrouver les siens. Mais, à son retour, son mari Mathias a disparu, ne laissant qu’un mot, et la police refuse d’enquêter. Mathias est majeur, s’il a disparu, c’est peut-être volontairement.

programme.title: Les Évaporés
programme.desc: Esther poursuit l’enquête sur la disparition de Mathias avec Frankie, une piste les mènent vers une avocate que son mari aurait consultée sous un faux prétexte de divorce. Pendant ce temps, Douma supporte les échecs de son équipe de basket et voit d’un mauvais oeil l’arrivée d’Esther dans l’univers du GRDV.

programme.title: Les Chemins de la Foi - le Jour du Seigneur
programme.desc: Giorgio La Pira est l’un des hommes politiques italiens les plus influents du XXe siècle. Celui qui s'est fait tertiaire dominicain et par dérogation franciscain, est un proche de la démocratie chrétienne : il est même l’un des rédacteurs de la Constitution italienne de 1948. Ancré dans un catholicisme social, il dirige Florence après-guerre, avec une telle aura qu’il est surnommé de son vivant le « saint maire ». Pourquoi ?

programme.title: Truk lagoon: le Grand Cimetière sous la Mer
programme.desc: Ce documentaire nous mène de l’autre côté de l’Histoire, en Micronésie, à Truk ; archipel oublié au milieu de l’océan Pacifique. Dans cet archipel, le sort d’un empire et celui de la moitié du monde a été scellé sous la mer les 17 et 18 février de 1944, lors de l’Opération de U.S. Navy, baptisée Hailstone. Les Américains ont fait sauter le verrou qui commandait l’issue de la guerre du Pacifique.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 122
programme.desc: Hélio procura Romeu. Adelaide desconfia de um comentário de Cristina. Carlito fala demais e Raul descobre um segredo. Começa o casamento de Rafael e Cristina.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 44
programme.desc: Madeleine acusa Gustavo de tê-la traído com Nayara. Irma não acredita quando Madeleine diz à irmã que reconquistará José Leôncio. Levi confronta Muda. Filó flagra Levi com Muda e manda a moça se decidir entre o peão e Tibério. Juma pede a Jove que não fale mais em ir embora. José Lucas está disposto a encontrar seu caminhão e fazer justiça. Felícia fica nervosa por estar sozinha com Gerson. Das Dores implica com Clara ao ver que ela recebeu um buquê de flores de Diogo. Mimi não consegue encontrar um lugar para morar e procura Jéssica, que convence Clô a deixá-lo trabalhar na mansão como mordomo.

programme.title: A Nobreza do Amor - Ep. 101
programme.desc: Diógenes avisa que Virgínia será punida com rigor. Ciço convida Mundica para a festa de São Pedro. Mirinho sofre um acidente ao se exercitar e fica com o pé imobilizado. Jendal promove um banquete para escolher a nova esposa. Dona Menina se recusa a fazer a imagem de Veneranda como Santa. Jendal solta Kênia soba ameaças. Diógenes obriga Virgínia a ajudar o padre na igreja.

programme.title: Orgulho e Paixão - Ep. 111
programme.desc: Susana se queixa de Elisabeta para Lady Margareth. Julieta pede perdão a Jane. Elisabeta reencontra Ema e Ernesto. Mário/Mariana deixa Otávio sozinho com Luccino. Fani procura Nicoletta. Jorge fica penalizado com Amélia. Brandão formaliza seu namoro com Mariana. Elisabeta e Julieta usam Olegário no plano. Randolfo pede Lídia em casamento. Susana se irrita com uma notícia no jornal de Elisabeta.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Bela e Lucas aprovam o plano das crianças de aproximar os dois. Iara e Dalila acreditam que Juarez estava brincando sobre a possível mudança. Gabriel não cede à pressão de Vanessa e afirma que os dois enfrentarão um divórcio litigioso. Próspero fica sentido pela tristeza de Toy por conta de Leandra. Margô nota a animação de Lucas. Maike conforta Toy. Sabugo busca Tom-Tom na casa de acolhimento.

programme.desc: Lenita tenta convencer Jô a não prejudicar Fábio. Gugu faz proposta a Braguinha. Jô se nega a tratar seu sonambulismo. Edson tem surpresa desagradável ao chegar em casa.

programme.desc: Edson sofre represália dos agiotas. Vitório decide contar a verdade para Gláucia. Braguinha responde Gugu sobre proposta para namorar Babi. O noivado de Jô e Rafael corre risco.

programme.desc: Mirinho acha graça ao ver Virgínia trabalhando na igreja. Virgínia se descontrola e ofende Lúcia/Alika, que acaba se defendendo das investidas agressivas da rival. Diógenes pede desculpas a Lúcia/Alika em nome de Virgínia. Pressionado, Manoel pede Ana Maria em namoro para Casemiro. Binta é escolhida rainha de Batanga. Malungo viaja rumo a Barro Preto.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 90
programme.desc: Marcelo e Diego discutem sobre o frigorífico. O desfile de Patrícia é um sucesso e, durante o evento, Carla e Sidney conversam. Juca e Ana marcam a data do casamento.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 123
programme.desc: Rafael e Cristina se casam. Guto promete se vingar de Cristina. Romeu conta um segredo de Generosa. Felipe sente ciúme de Mirella. Rafael toma uma decisão.

programme.title: Orgulho e Paixão - Ep. 112
programme.desc: Lídia dá esperanças para Randolfo. Aurélio se envergonha do Barão. Elisabeta comemora a notícia de jornal sobre Susana. Julieta humilha Susana. Agatha é irônica ao ver Mariana e Brandão juntos. Fani tira satisfações com Cecília. Susana obriga Darcy a acompanhá-la na compra de seu vestido de noiva. Ofélia exige que Lídia aceite o pedido de casamento de Randolfo. Elisabeta enfrenta Susana na loja.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Iara se desespera com a casa revirada, e Bela e Dalila a apoiam. Juarez se sente aliviado ao notar que as peças de Zé ainda estão em seu esconderijo. Peixe resgata pertences de Juli e seus irmãos. Juarez confronta Zé, e Próspero alerta o amigo sobre o suposto mecânico. Bela pede que Peixe não volte à sua casa antiga. Gabriel garante a Ricardo que lutará para resgatar sua história com Bela.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 45
programme.desc: Muda beija Levi e revela ao peão o seu objetivo de vingança. Trindade aconselha Tibério a mandar Levi embora. Durante conversa com Madeleine, Irma acaba confessando à irmã que dormiu com José Leôncio. Madeleine acusa Irma de traidora. Tadeu defende Guta ao flagrar Tenório destratando a própria filha. Tadeu declara seu amor a Guta e os dois acabam se amando.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 171
programme.desc: Josué conta para Maria Isis que o Comendador está preso. José Alfredo leva um tapa de Maria Marta.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 159
programme.desc: Danilo não reconhece Gerson e desmaia. Fred ameaça Mauro. Gerson leva Danilo para uma clínica de reabilitação. Cavarzere aconselha Totó e Clara a permanecerem mais tempo juntos em casa para que possam convencer a assistente social de que são felizes. Fátima e Alfredo ficam solidários ao sofrimento de Kelly. Clara se emociona com as suas antigas fotos na sala de Totó.

programme.title: Extreme Forensics T2 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Uma cidade é virada do avesso quando uma rapariga desaparece. Quando é encontrada violada e estrangulada no bosque local, o principal suspeito é um vizinho de 14 anos.

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Na véspera de Ano Novo, uma ex-líder de claque vai a uma festa e é encontrada morta no dia seguinte. O vídeo caseiro da festa identifica o assassino.

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A capitã da claque Tristyn Bailey desaparece e a polícia explora rumores e mexericos de adolescentes na cidade da Florida para saber o que aconteceu.

programme.title: I Went Undercover T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Jim aborda a polícia com uma pista do crime chocante de um amigo só para participar nas buscas e limpar o seu próprio nome. Para chegar à verdade, tem de trabalhar infiltrado.

programme.title: I Went Undercover T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Um triângulo de amor ilícito termina num assassinato. Quando surgem gravações, uma história de amizade, amor e traição envolve uma pequena cidade do Missouri.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door T4 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Quando Kari desaparece, nenhum dos seus vizinhos consegue imaginar porque alguém poderia querer-lhe mal. Sem corpo e sem pistas, a Polícia tem dificuldades com este caso.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door T4 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Quando estava prestes a fazer a sua estreia artística, Kristin desaparece e a Polícia descobre que ela já tinha tido um encontro com a morte. Saiba quem queria matá-la.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Um grupo de homens descobre o corpo de uma mulher num parque em Red Valley, Arizona. Os investigadores têm pistas, mas poderão reunir provas concretas suficientes?

programme.title: Hostage 911 T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Negociadores intercedem junto de um homem que faz a sua mulher refém após esta pedir o divórcio, mas ele tem um plano que pode ter um desfecho fatal.

programme.title: Hostage 911 T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Negociadores esperam conseguir convencer um ex-condenado que fez refém o seu antigo advogado e ameaça detonar uma bomba se não for feita justiça.

programme.title: 911: Did The Killer Call? T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A polícia encontra um professor assassinado e as suspeitas recaem para as pessoas da casa. A verdade é mais trágica do que se poderia imaginar.

programme.title: Hostage: Deadly Demands T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Quando Lois Platt escreve para o recluso Larry Hill, ela pensa que está apenas a ajudá-lo. Porém, ele acaba por aparecer em sua casa e por fazê-la refém.

programme.title: Hostage: Deadly Demands T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Durante anos, Laura sofreu com a atenção indesejada de um colega, Richard Farley. Este acaba por ser despedido, mas volta ao escritório, armado.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T4 - Ep. 2

Athena pousse Chimney à se réconcilier avec Hen après son licenciement, mais leur discussion tourne vite à la dispute. Pendant ce temps, un nouvel assistant IA, censé faciliter le travail au centre d'appels, complique davantage les choses et oblige l'équipe à intervenir. Les proches d'Hen organisent une confrontation pour l'aider.
Un déraillement de train mobilise toute la brigade 118. Buck recroise Abby dont le compagnon est bloqué dans le train.

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: Philippe Etchebest se rend à Brive-la-Gaillarde pour venir en aide à Amina, restauratrice depuis 35 ans. Si pendant des années son restaurant a été un succès, aujourd'hui Amina est complètement dépassée et son établissement est passé de 200 couverts par jour à... 2 ! Le chef va découvrir un laisser-aller incroyable et l'une des cuisines les plus grasses qu'il ait jamais vues, l'obligeant même à s'équiper pour inspecter les lieux !

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: Philippe Etchebest se rend en bord de mer, dans le sud de la France à Agde, pour tenter de venir en aide à Frédéric, le propriétaire d’une crêperie installée dans un cadre idyllique. Sur le papier, l’établissement possède tous les atouts pour réussir.

programme.title: Recherche Appartement Ou Maison
programme.desc: Myriam, 35 ans, Mehdi, 37 ans, et leurs 3 enfants ont quitté la région parisienne pour Lyon ! Quitter Paris c’est pouvoir acheter une maison plutôt qu’un appartement. Myriam et Medhi veulent aussi plus de verdure, tout en gardant une vie citadine. Sandra Viricel va mener une incroyable opération sélection pour trouver la grande maison avec piscine dont rêve la famille.

programme.title: Recherche Appartement Ou Maison
programme.desc: À Marseille, Nadine et Lionel, 63 ans et jeunes retraités, souhaitent quitter la maison qu’ils ont construite pour se rapprocher de leur fille, près d’Aix-en-Provence. Ils recherchent une demeure de charme avec un grand terrain, un vaste séjour et assez d’espace pour leur famille et le piano de Lionel. Après de nombreuses visites infructueuses, ils comptent sur Sandra Viricel pour trouver leur bonheur.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: A HSI Miami investiga dois casos de tráfico marítimo e apreende mais de 450 kg de cocaína num iate proveniente das Caraíbas. O Serviço de Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras aperta o cerco à importação ilegal de medicamentos, tendo em mente a preocupação com a saúde e a segurança das pessoas. E o Serviço de Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras de Miami descobre cocaína escondida num local improvável: a sola dos sapatos de um passageiro.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: O HSI investiga vários casos de cocaína traficados a partir das Caraíbas por via marítima. O Serviço de Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras faz grandes apreensões de medicação sem receita médica.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A MIA CBP identifica um passageiro com viagens frequentes à Colômbia e, após interrogatório, suspeitam que ele possa estar a traficar narcóticos internamente. Os agentes procuram narcóticos em carga, estando um passo à frente do cartel. No JFK, é levada a cabo uma entrega controlada de ecstasy em Wall Street que foi interceptada por correio e no LAX, dois passageiros são interrogados sobre as suas visitas.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Após perderem Gary Muehlberger, um ancião da comunidade, num trágico incêndio, os residentes de Port Protection vêem-se forçados a enfrentar a sua perda e seguir em frente. programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 2
