programme.title: Killer Safari T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Killer Safari T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: When the savannah turns into a battleground, it’s hard to choose a hero. We’re on the edge of our safari seats as a leopard is cornered by a pride of lions, a young impala is hurled into the air by a hippo and two hyenas try to drown each other. Then, the rarest of sightings as an Aardvark runs for its life from a brown hyaena. Who will win when it’s tooth versus claw?.

programme.title: Killer Safari T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Life in the African bush is a game of survival, for both hunter and hunted. Add babies to the mix and you’ll see astounding feats of courage as mothers risk life and limb to protect their young. In spring, tall grass helps babies hide out of sight, but it also camouflages predators on the prowl. This game drive captures extraordinary behaviour as families and individuals battle to eat, defend, and raise young.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T23 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Its the most wonderful time of the year! As PVS decks the halls, a reindeers hurt hoof threatens his Christmas Eve take-off. Dr. Pol treats an abandoned puppy discovered on a cold silent night. Dr. Nicole rushes to a cow that isnt acting right while Dr. Lisa assists a young cat struggling to breathe.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T23 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: The staffers become the clients as they bring in their pets for the vets to treat. Dr. Pol builds a special cast for an injured calf, Dr. Lisa chases a pair of goats, and Dr. Brenda has to change her plans when a reindeers symptoms suddenly change. With a goose, bunny, and pregnant pup all at the clinic, the staff works hard keeping Pol Vet running smoothly. .

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce.

With a goose, bunny, and pregnant pup all at the clinic, the staff works hard keeping Pol Vet running smoothly. .

programme.title: Killer Safari T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Killer Safari T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: If you're a forest predator, success requires using trees to bridge the gap between life and death. In this realm, danger - or your next meal - could be behind you, below, or above you. Whether you're a Harpy eagle, zeroing in on prey from high in the rainforest canopy, a cunning weasel, scouring for a meal in and out of mossy logs, or a Bengal tiger, trying to stalk in a bare, dry forest, catching prey among the trees is a challenge.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators T1 - Ep. 4

programme.title: Killer Safari T2 - Ep. 2

The safari intensifies as a leopard, wild dogs and hyenas fight for the same kill in an astonishing display of raw nature.
